author: Y Combinator
description:
Much of the AI conversation focuses on which desk jobs will get replaced. But for physical work, AI can't yet act in the world.

With multimodal models and ubiquitous hardware, there’s an opportunity to give workers live AI coaching that dramatically reduces training time and unlocks skilled labor at scale.

Apply to YC Spring 2026 at ycombinator.com/apply.
title: AI Guidance for Physical Work
